_about: The buildable shield (core/shield_state.gd decides, game/player.gd carries it, game/shield_model.gd is the model; where its parts lie and where it is built: data/buildables.json). hits = blocked hits it lasts; boss_cost = hits a boss's blow costs. arc_deg = the slice it covers: centred straight BEHIND you while it hangs on your back, straight AHEAD while it is in hand; a hit from inside the slice does no damage. move_speed = top speed with it in hand (Source units, as data/weapons.json). bash (the shoot key with it in hand): damage to every enemy within reach_m inside bash arc_deg ahead, they are thrown back by push (m/s), interval and hit_at in seconds as data/knives.json attacks, wear = hits a bash costs the shield. view = where it sits in first person (metres from the eye, degrees).
name: Hatch Shield
